meta.parties: Esabella Perera Hamine v. Emalia Perera Hamine

rules.statement: The court can use its inherent power to restore a tenant's possession when the eviction was obtained through an abuse of process, even if there is another remedy available.
rules.supporting_quote: Therefore upon: an application of ratio in the case of Seneviratne v. Abeykoon (Supra) the respondent could be restored to possession by means of the inherent power of the Court.
